preconditions.description: The number of independent games T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Q <= 10**18 for Q in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query Q must be an integer between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.
No more than 22 queries are allowed per game.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= 10**9 for X in hidden_numbers)
preconditions.description: Each hidden number X is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(gcd_response, int) and gcd_response >= 1 for gcd_response in gcd_responses)
preconditions.description: Each GCD response is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(ans - d) <= 7 or (1/2 <= ans/d <= 2) for ans, d in zip(answers, true_divisor_counts))
postconditions.description: For each game, the answer ans must satisfy either an absolute error ≤ 7 or a relative error between 0.5 and 2 when compared to the true number of divisors d of X.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(ans, int) for ans in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer ans must be an integer.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a precondition that the number of games T is provided as the first input line.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: The first line of input contains one integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 100) — the number of games.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a precondition that the hidden number X is fixed per game and non-adaptive.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: The number X is fixed before all queries. In other words, interactor is not adaptive.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a precondition that the GCD responses correspond to the hidden X and the queried Q.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: In response, you will get gcd(X, Q) — the greatest common divisor of X and Q.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a precondition that the answers must be printed in the format '! ans' after queries.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: If you are confident that you have figured out the number of divisors of X with enough precision, you can print your answer in '! ans' format.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a precondition that the program must terminate after the last game.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: If this was the last game, you have to terminate the program, otherwise you have to start the next game immediately.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a postcondition that the program must output queries in the format '? Q' and flush stdout after each query.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: To make a query print a line '? Q' ... After printing a query do not forget to output end of line and flush the output.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a postcondition that the program must handle T independent games sequentially.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: In one test you will have to play T independent games, that is, guess the number of divisors T times for T independent values of X.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a postcondition that the program must not exceed 22 queries per game.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: You can make no more than 22 such queries during one game.
